entries.source: Monumenta Boica 1, Monumenta Atilensia, N. XV, Donatio Prædii in Puech
entries.latin:
Universa que geruntur in tempore, ne labantur cum tempore,
poni debent in lingua testium, & scripture memorie per-
hennari. Nos igitur Hainricus divina miseracione Abbas in Atele
hanc paginam inspecturis constare volumus universis, quod Domi-
nus Conradus de Sebrucce quoddam predium in Puech situm emit
a Domino Conrado de Penzingen, quod idem miles Domine Perthe
uxori sue iure dotalitii donaverat: & processu temporis mortuis
testibus, in quorum presencia dicta emptio fuerat pertractata,
dictus miles Chunradus de Sebruck timens emptionem suam per obliuionis
calumpniam infirmari, memoratos Dominum Conradum de Pen-
zingen & uxorem suam Pertham in Isen accessivit, ubi illi annu-
ente milite de Sebrucke emptionis de predio dicto facte testimo-
nium perhibuerunt eidem, in presencia subscriptorum; Domini
Heinrici de Lengendorf, Domini Chunradi de Rosenperg militum, Ul-
rici & Magani de Laupach, Chunradi de Lengendorff, & Filii sui
Heinrici, Heinrici de Hoselmthal, Sibotonis Klechilin, Priedlibi, Ulrici
Hoknhaver, Hermanni de Puech, Ulrici Prem. Hoc predium
liberum postmodum Dominus Chunradus de Seprucke pro remedio
anime sue & uxoris sue, nec non & omnium parentum suorum
donavit Monasterio Atelensi; tali interposita condicione, quod
ipse quamdiu vixerit, dictum predium libere possidebit, hoc ex-
cepto, quod in spem muneris delegati, Atelensi Monasterio annua-
tim autumpnalia serviencia, de memorato predio provenientia, ex-
hibebit, & post mortem ipsius etiamsi heredes reliquerit, dictum
in Puech predium ab omni advocatia liberum, omni contradictione
postposita perpetuo serviet Atelensi Ecclesie prelibate. Ne vero
donacioni nobis facte processu temporis aliqua contradictionis sive
cavillacionis materia obviare attemptet, presentem cedulam nostro
sigillo, & sigillo venerabilis Domini Abbatis Rotensis, qui ad
peticionem Chunradi de Seprucke militis antedicti suum sigillum
apponendum presentibus duxit, sumus contenti, Ego Chunradus
de Sebruck, antedictus cum sigillo proprio caream, sigillo Venerabilis
Domini Abbatis Rotensis in hac parte usus sum. Nos Chunra-
dus divina miseracione Abbas in Rott ad peticionem Chunradi Mili-
tis sepedicti nostrum sigillum presentibus duximus appendendum.
Huius rei testes sunt Dominus Chunradus Prior, Dominus Frede-
ricus & Heinricus sacerdotes, Heinricus Diaconus, Heinricus,
Sifridus, Ulricus, Conradus Confratres, Heinricus Claviger, Al-
bero cocus, Bertoldus Preco, Heinricus Bobeliz, & filius suus
Heinricus, Gebhardus, Chunradus, calcifices, Fridericus molendi-
nator in Atel, Dominus Chunradus, & Dominus Heinricus Creze-
lim, Chunradus de Volinigen, Dominus Rudgerus de Celle, Dominus
Heinricus Rinderfuos, Heinricus & Chunradus de Hauenheim, Chunradus
de Ebenhausen, Heinricus Kreiberger, Gebhardus Chirmers, Ulricus
Meinhalm, Conradus Claviger Ducis & alii quam plures. Acta
sunt hec Anno Domini MCCLV. XI. Kalend. Aprilis.
entries.english: Whatever is done in time, so that it does not fade with time, ought to be placed in the tongue of witnesses and preserved in the memory of writing. We therefore, Heinrich, by divine mercy abbot in Attel, wish it to be known to all who will inspect this page that Lord Konrad von Sebruck bought a certain estate situated in Puech from Lord Konrad von Penzingen, which the same knight had given to Lady Pertha his wife as dower. In the course of time the witnesses in whose presence the said purchase had been negotiated died, and the said knight Konrad von Sebruck, fearing that his purchase might be weakened by the slander of oblivion, approached the aforementioned Lord Konrad von Penzingen and his wife Pertha in Isen, where they, with the knight von Sebruck consenting, gave him testimony of the purchase of the said estate, in the presence of the undersigned: Lord Heinrich von Lengendorf, Lord Konrad von Rosenberg, knights, Ulrich and Magan von Laupach, Konrad von Lengendorff and his son Heinrich, Heinrich von Hoselmthal, Siboto Klechilin, Priedlib, Ulrich Hoknhaver, Hermann von Puech, Ulrich Prem. Afterwards Lord Konrad von Sebruck gave this free estate to the monastery of Attel for the remedy of his soul and that of his wife, and of all his parents, on the condition that he shall possess the said estate freely as long as he lives, except that, in hope of the office delegated to him, he shall render to the monastery of Attel each year the autumn services arising from the said estate; and after his death, even if he leaves heirs, the said estate in Puech, free of all advocacy, shall serve the aforesaid church of Attel in perpetuity, every objection set aside. So that no matter of objection or quibbling may in time oppose the donation made to us, we are content with our seal and the seal of the venerable Lord Abbot of Rott, who at the request of the aforesaid knight Konrad von Seprucke ordered his seal to be affixed to this document. I, Konrad von Sebruck, the aforesaid, lacking a seal of my own, have used in this matter the seal of the venerable Lord Abbot of Rott. We, Konrad, by divine mercy abbot in Rott, at the request of the often-named knight Konrad have had our seal appended to this document. Witnesses of this matter are: Lord Konrad, prior; Lord Friedrich and Heinrich, priests; Heinrich, deacon; Heinrich, Siegfried, Ulrich, Konrad, confreres; Heinrich, steward; Albero, cook; Berthold, herald; Heinrich Bobeliz and his son Heinrich; Gebhard and Konrad, shoemakers; Friedrich, miller in Attel; Lord Konrad and Lord Heinrich Crezelim; Konrad von Volinigen; Lord Rudger von Celle; Lord Heinrich Rinderfuos; Heinrich and Konrad von Hauenheim; Konrad von Ebenhausen; Heinrich Kreiberger; Gebhard Chirmers; Ulrich Meinhalm; Konrad, steward of the Duke; and many others. Done in the year of the Lord 1255, on the 11th day before the Kalends of April.

facts.content: bought an estate in Puech from Konrad von Penzingen.
had given the estate in Puech to his wife Pertha as dower.
gave the estate in Puech to the monastery of Attel for the remedy of his soul, his wife's soul and the souls of his parents, keeping it for life against annual autumn services.
testified at Isen, together with his wife Pertha, to the purchase of the estate in Puech by Konrad von Sebruck.
issued the charter and sealed it.
sealed the charter at the request of Konrad von Sebruck.
was present at Isen as a witness of the testimony on the purchase of the estate in Puech.
